title: Reduce complete affine/vector replay by 7.82% beyond cached masks (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The complete nine-screen affine/vector replay can reuse its preceding polynomial-code row. The new opt-in adapter reduces median complete-command time by **7.82% beyond the published mask-cache method**, from 0.870415 s to 0.802367 s on this host.

```text
retain the preceding exact row P_j(base)
if popcount(i xor j) < popcount(i): apply P_(i xor j) to that row
otherwise: apply P_i to the base
run every original row, rank, upstream and certificate check
```

Claim type: measured verifier improvement with a scoped equivalence proof and exact finite conformance evidence. This answers [PR2210's polynomial-code performance question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7/research/leech-minor-production/README.md#open-next-questions). [PR1075](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1075) already supplies mask caching. The additional incremental row step is the new contribution; no predecessor mathematical theorem is audited or claimed as new.

The package, proof, exact source pins and generated timing receipt are in [research/polynomial-code-row-stream](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/304ecd1e31e5f6928b4472690bb1959931ad263e/research/polynomial-code-row-stream). Scientific base is canonical main `a5bff3bf133e482541c09eba4e773884bdb2b1b7`, priority revision 8. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19272230).

## Evidence

- Five alternating fresh-process samples per engine produce fifteen byte-identical complete outputs and zero errors. Incremental range is 0.800517–0.811994 s; cached range is 0.868530–0.872415 s. The original uncached source has median 2.723721 s; most of that larger gain belongs to the credited cache method. CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64. Timings are local measurements, not CI performance thresholds.
- Every one of the 3,074 actual polynomial witness rows agrees exactly with both retained engines. Block swaps fall from 12,949 to 5,501. The unchanged five Leech screens and binary elimination limit further gains.
- The checker also passes 2,122 exhaustive small row/index pairs, 21,865 wider/history fixtures, a maximum-width fixture, twelve invalid warm-state inputs and two internal corruption discriminators. All three engines reproduce the complete committed nine-screen certificate.
- Local warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks pass in 6.66 s and 6.65 s. Both registered checks pass, together in 13.54 s, each against a 120 s limit. Committed bytes, modes and full source history pass for 51 package/input files. The official export checks all 41 declared inputs. Read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay and source/benchmark-corruption controls pass, preserving all 52 exported files' bytes and modes.

From the repository root, reproduce with the standard-library CPython 3.12 interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/polynomial-code-row-stream/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/polynomial-code-row-stream/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/polynomial-code-row-stream
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/polynomial-code-row-stream --check-source-history --check-modes
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/polynomial-code-row-stream/benchmark.py
```

Another CPython 3.12 path may be substituted. Expected scientific marker: `PASS_POLYNOMIAL_CODE_ROW_STREAM`. The accelerated complete command is `replay.py` with the same interpreter flags; `--engine cached` and `--engine original` select the comparators. Replay writes no artifacts by default.

## Limitations

This is historical verification engineering, with no new kappa, support theorem, supplier or complete multiplication theorem. The adapter admits widths through 2^21 and uses temporary module-reference substitution in a standalone process. Concurrent use and production adoption are outside its contract. Native, compiler, precision, physical-tape, BIT, outer and selected cold replays were not run. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can the incremental engine be adopted in the production polynomial-code caller? Begin with one explicit caller substitution and regenerate every affected source pin and certificate. Production integration and its dependent manifests are outside this package; no further optimization is reserved.

## Related open work

The completion refresh inspected all fifteen other open account PRs created since the advance CLAIM. None studies this complete affine/vector certificate or incremental polynomial-code witness traversal, and none reports a conflicting same-instance value. No additional computations were run to compare unrelated results. PR2210 and PR1075 are merged predecessors. Earlier open-PR, Discussion and distinctive main-tree searches had complete remote pagination but incomplete sparse local-note coverage; unpublished work remains outside that coverage.

## CI notes

Both `plan` and `replay (research/polynomial-code-row-stream)` passed at exact head `304ecd1e31e5f6928b4472690bb1959931ad263e` in [run 40912957698](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40912957698). The hosted registered replay passed; CI does not certify the local timing percentage, independent scientific acceptance or the complete multiplication theorem.

Credit Douglas Colkitt for the original affine/vector screens and XOR operation, Jerry Chen / CubeJerry for PR898's Leech byte lanes, Victor Li / VictorLiwentao for PR2210's production wiring and explicit question, and Ross Richardson for PR1075's unchanged mask-cache comparator. The permutation identity and incremental traversal are standard techniques; all predecessor credit remains intact.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way. An isolated opt-in package.

**Blast Radius:** Package. Production sources, historical packages and the selected frontier retain their existing bytes.
